meaning: Handoff administration only: this tool does not execute work, validate scientific content or semantic claims, or alter the ideas registry.

proposals.distinguishing_observation: Predeclare an exact pair and successor table with a non-pair control; recurrence in at least two packet paragraphs supports the mechanism, mixed paragraph-specific order supports the rival.
linked_consequences: qoteedy-to-qokeedy direction should recur across f77r and f85r1
successor classes should remain stable without English glosses
proposals.nearest_rival: The frequent qoteedy/qokeedy forms are unrelated lexical words.
proposals.shared_mechanism: A reused qo kernel carries one content participant while eedy/teedy variation marks a state-to-process relation.
proposals.strongest_likely_failure: Few pairs and paragraph/position concentration leave no discriminator; old 50 values remain unconfirmed.

proposals.distinguishing_observation: Compare a predeclared exact-kernel/neighbor inventory against a matched null; a signal needs both cross-paragraph kernel reuse and neighbor reuse, not merely the letters ol.
linked_consequences: related ol compounds should preserve kernel and neighbor classes across f80v and f85r1
olshedy-qokeedy should share a local relation at f77r.23 and f85r1.4
proposals.nearest_rival: Every ol-family form is an unrelated whole word.
proposals.shared_mechanism: An ol shell modifies a retained kernel such as kain, shey or shedy; bare ol supplies the local relation without an assigned English value.
proposals.strongest_likely_failure: The dense f80v run is register-specific and cross-paragraph neighbors fail; GDT945/GDT946 narrow olal contracts already fail known sides.

proposals.distinguishing_observation: Write source-group aligned raw strings, separators and invariant stems before any majority vote; two invariant ordered slots plus one differing reader boundary are required.
linked_consequences: aligned kernel order should survive RF marks at f77r.23, f80v.32/.36 and f85r1.4
the same local relation should recur at two loci while qok[a:o]l/qokol/qokal stays an explicit terminal rival
proposals.nearest_rival: Each reader records independent lexical segmentation and apparent common forms are coincidence or editorial convergence.
proposals.shared_mechanism: Reader-specific marks and spacing change surface segmentation while preserving a shared ordered kernel and relation-slot spine.
proposals.strongest_likely_failure: The spine reflects transcriber convention or high-frequency forms; RF leaves most of f85r1.4 unresolved.

result.summary: Three bounded, distinct source-grounded hypotheses were retained after route-check and bounded ideas search. They are exploratory only: no word meaning was selected, no old value was promoted, and all three-reader differences remain explicit.

result.audit_example: Under GDT946's fixed immediate-neighbor rule, ZL f80v.36 olal has an uncertain boundary and stays NOT_TESTABLE, while exact IT/RF olshedy olal shedy is COMPATIBLE. At f107r.21 taror olal okain, the known right-side okain mismatch remains KNOWN_SIDE_CONTRADICTION even if another neighbor is unknown: unknowns can block evaluation, never turn a known failure into PASS.

constraints.discriminator: The recurrence alone does not distinguish compositional components from a stored whole-phrase template. It would distinguish only a preregistered rival predicting no recurrence; component versus whole-phrase reuse requires a further test of internal substitutions or role transfer. This is structural evidence, not evidence for any gloss.
constraints.observation: The same consecutive listed groups qoteedy qokaiin shedy recur at f77r.11 G001-G003 and f77r.14 G004-G006 in both ZL3b and IT2a. The consecutive listed olshedy qokeedy groups recur across pages at f77r.23 G005-G006 and f85r1.4 G005-G006 in ZL3b/IT2a; RF retains the loci but marks the forms uncertain. Per-group separator flags are unavailable in EXPOSED_PARAGRAPHS, so this is a source-group recurrence claim, not an extra spacing claim.

constraints.discriminator: These observations contradict only a rival requiring one fixed line-boundary position for an exact token. They do not contradict a flexible word-order account in which the same token keeps a participant or grammatical role at different positions; component versus whole-form role requires a separate substitution/transfer test. Structural predecessors GDT608/GDT282/GDT286/GDT318 motivate retaining entry context and residual whole-form information; no translation follows.
constraints.observation: In the provided line grouping, shedy is non-final (f77r.11 G003; f77r.16 G005) and the last listed group (f80v.32 G009; f85r1.6 G007). qokeedy is the first listed group (f77r.13 G001; f80v.33 G001) and non-first (f77r.23 G006; f85r1.4 G006). EXPOSED_PARAGRAPHS lacks per-group separator flags, so these are line-position constraints only.

constraints.discriminator: Any candidate must state its reader/segmentation contract. A claimed invariant lexeme count or three-reader replication is invalid where group boundaries differ; RF is an alternate reading of the same manuscript, not independent support.
constraints.observation: The same locus changes grouping/raw form: f77r.9 has ZL poldarais (one G001), IT pol G001 + darair G002, and RF poldarairol G001; f77r.12 has ZL she[a:o]lol G007, IT sheol G007 + ol G008, and RF sheolol G007. RF also carries uncertainty markers at f77r.23 G005 and f85r1.4 G005-G006.

failure_modes: Do not promote LEXICONS German glosses (liquid/flow/pipe, etc.) to evidence or invent same-portion identity for repeated forms.
Do not select only compatible loci, skip RF uncertainty, or merge ZL/IT/RF as independent manuscripts; GDT945/946 show this masks failed fixed contracts.
Do not let unknown neighbors repair a known contradiction or become arbitrary fillers; preserve UNBOUND/NOT_TESTABLE as capacity limits.
root_review_corrections: C1 recurrence cannot select compositional analysis over stored whole-phrase reuse; an internal substitution or role-transfer test would be required.
C2 position variation constrains only fixed line-boundary rules; flexible word order can preserve participant or grammatical roles.
result.summary: Raw evidence supports structural comparisons only; no confirmed anchor, meaning, or winner between content+word-building and rivals. German values in LEXICONS and GDT945/946 remain hypotheses.

result.limitations: Read-only workflow helper; no worker launch, API, subprocess execution, semantic or scientific result validation, registry mutation, or background service.
result.summary: Implemented and hardened a standalone stdlib validate/brief/collect CLI with schema, selector seal, lexical packet path, symlink/path, input hash, task ownership, output collision, and existing regular evidence file checks. It does not execute jobs or validate scientific meaning.
